style: Use this exact character: small glowing mint-green gummy blob, black pixel-LED sunglasses with green dot lenses, small smile, little green flag. Stylized 3D character in a real photographic world, cinematic, 16:9 widescreen. Fill the whole frame with the scene.
negative: deformed character, extra limbs, fingers, text, watermark, blurry

s09.keyframe: Sunlit kitchen in the morning: the character peeks out from behind a white coffee mug on the counter, much smaller than the mug; behind it a toaster is smoking, the toast burnt black. Warm golden window light, shallow depth of field.
s09.motion: The small glowing mint-green character peeks out from behind the coffee mug, ducks back, then peeks out again with a little wave of its green flag, bouncing on the beat. Smoke curls up from the burnt toast. Slow gentle push-in, warm morning light.

s12.keyframe: Cinematic macro photo: a smartphone lying in tall grass at golden hour; the character is halfway out of the glowing screen, one stubby arm on the phone's edge, climbing out into a jungle of giant grass blades. Warm backlight, dew, shallow depth of field.
s12.motion: The small glowing mint-green gummy character in black pixel sunglasses pulls itself up out of the rippling liquid phone screen in three bouncy heaves, one on each beat, pops free and lands in the grass, then raises its little green flag. The camera swoops low through the giant dewy grass blades and rises up into a wide golden-hour park. Warm backlight, lens flare, playful energetic motion.

s01.keyframe: Dark bedroom at 2 AM: a man in his thirties (short dark messy hair, light stubble, black-framed glasses, grey hoodie) lies in bed in profile, face lit cold blue by a phone propped on the pillow beside him, the scrolling feed reflected in his glasses, tired eyes. On the phone's glowing screen, tiny, the character stands inside the glass tapping on it from the inside. Deep shadows, blue light, cinematic, no hands in frame.
s01.motion: Almost still. The blue light flickers as the feed scrolls; his eyes track the screen. Inside the phone the tiny glowing character taps the glass twice. Very slow push-in toward the phone.
s01.foley: two soft glass taps from inside the screen

s02.keyframe: Close-up of a phone screen glowing in a dark bedroom, an endless social feed of blurred posts streaming past; the tiny glowing character stands inside the screen in front of the feed, looking out at the viewer, waving its little green flag.
s02.motion: The camera pushes forward into the phone screen in three surges, one on each 'down', until the glowing feed fills the frame and the camera passes through the glass into the stream of posts; the little character beckons it in.
s02.foley: a deep whoom on each push, the last one opening into a glassy rush

s03.keyframe: Abstract: falling through a tunnel of streaking blue and white light, blurred feed posts and notification bubbles stretched into long light streaks, the tiny glowing mint-green character tumbling among them, its green flag fluttering.
s03.motion: A fast continuous fall through streaks of light that accelerate and stretch; the character tumbles past the camera; at the very end everything flares to white, ready to match-cut into the verse.
s03.foley: a rising whoosh that ENDS on the drop at 11.53 (the next bar); the echoed 'hey hey hey' is already in the song
s03.match_cut_to: s04 (open verse 1 on a frame that matches the white flare)

theme: The camera gets pulled into the doomscroller's world inside the phone; Blip is there to add color and reset him back to real life.
